scope: Independent local investment cost-basis correction, persistence and UI acceptance

host_integration.backend: Actual isolated same-origin HTTP API and committed SQLite rows

primary_groups: Real identical-description lots have separate UUIDs and actual initial gain/refund
Actual correction dialog replaces only the selected absolute basis and recalculates tax
Real helper rejects stale/conflicting/invalid proposals and duplicate UUIDs; exact replay is no-op
Cent-equivalent UI entry keeps identity/history; real save and relaunch checkpoint persist
Actual JSON download and restore as new return preserve correction history and recomputed result
Deletion and addition preserve the surviving corrected lot identity/history
Actual offline tax worker and IndexedDB save/reopen/backup retain corrected gain and event
browser.paper_fact_group: Actual Filing details labeled dates and category select store separately from unchanged calculation records; real worker schema matches Python and facts persist after relaunch
browser.environment: Real headless Chromium, actual UI, downloads and JSON restore; real Pyodide dedicated worker and IndexedDB
browser.external_requests: Aborted in the test contexts; all successful calculations used local resources
paper_fact_fields_actually_entered: Brokerage reporting category A/B/C or D/E/F (actual SELECT)

synthetic_tax_result.note: The independent synthetic case deliberately leaves unrelated household and filing confirmations unanswered. These figures are calculation acceptance, not a filed return.

behaviors_verified: Equal descriptions have distinct stable record IDs; correction affects only the selected lot
Cent-equivalent amount formatting preserves IDs, fingerprints and history
Exact correction-ID replay returns already_applied without appending or changing data
Same correction ID with different target or basis is rejected
Stale proposal and replay after a later manual basis edit are rejected
Invalid money, duplicate record IDs and correction IDs are rejected without changing saved return
Save, relaunch, actual JSON download and restore as a new return preserve history and recompute tax
Deletion and addition preserve the surviving corrected lot; new lot starts without history
Real local worker/IndexedDB save, reopen and backup preserve corrected result and history
Paper-form dates/category occupy their own namespace; calculation records and IDs remain unchanged
limitations: No remote brokerage or paid import backend was exercised
No original TurboTax runtime parity or pixel parity is claimed
Undo is not asserted as implemented
Browser worker acceptance does not replace separately recorded native mobile/desktop package checks
Only synthetic financial inputs were used; no phone photographs or private taxpayer returns were read

reproduction.note: Run host commands from outputs/tax-reborn. Browser scripts run from the repository workspace with Playwright installed and TAX_REBORN_TEST_PYTHON pointing to a Python runtime that supports the server and PDF dependencies.
